description: This file defines the interface for configuring and installing a failure signal handler in the Abseil C++ library, including options for symbolization, alternate stack usage, signal handling, and callback functions.

classes.name: FailureSignalHandlerOptions
classes.description: Struct holding configuration options for the failure signal handler, including symbolization, alternate stack, alarm timeout, signal chaining, and a custom writer function.

methods.name: InstallFailureSignalHandler
methods.description: Function to install a signal handler for common fatal signals, enabling debugging information to be dumped upon program failure.
